newsitem.title: BELGIUM: W.Europe car registrations up 12.2 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: W.Europe car registrations up 12.2 pct in Sept.

text.p: New passenger car registrations in Western Europe rose 12.2 percent to 971,600 in September from the same period a year earlier, the European car manufacturers association, ACEA, said on Monday.
They said registrations for the period January to September 1996 were up 6.7 percent at 10,052,200 from the same period a year earlier.
